definitions: To recover from an illness or an unpleasant experience.
To overcome a problem or difficulty.
To accept an unpleasant fact or situation after being upset or angry about it.
To stop being affected or bothered by someone or something.
examples: It took her a long time to get over the flu.
He's finding it hard to get over his ex-girlfriend.
You need to get over your fear of public speaking.
She never really got over the death of her pet.
